sources.title: mxbai edge colbert v0 32m — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact, retrieval-focused specialist that uses ColBERT's late interaction mechanism to compare query and document tokens individually rather than collapsing everything into a single vector. At 32M parameters it runs efficiently on edge devices, making it practical for on-device search pipelines.
